ns2:course.label: Off-Campus Internship
ns2:course.description: Supervised, off-campus experience in a field directly pertaining to subject matter in Human Development and Family Studies. Intended primarily for students seeking supervised internship experience needed for certification as a Child Life Specialist. Approved for letter and S/U grading. May be repeated to a maximum of 4 hours. Prerequisite: Prior or concurrent enrollment in HDFS 408 and consent of instructor.
